newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CVRD worth 10 bln reais - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CVRD worth 10 bln reais - report.

text.p: The president of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said soon-to-be-privatized mining giant Companhia do Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) is now worth 10 billion reais ($10 billion), a financial newspaper said.
Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros said the value of CVRD shares rose 15 to 20 percent following last week's publication of the company's privatization model, Gazeta Mercantil said.
"The company, which was valued at seven to eight billion reais at the beginning of the privatization process, is now worth around 10 billion reais," Gazeta quoted de Barros as saying.
He said the exemption of exports from the so-called ICMS tax may add a further 600 million reais ($600 million) to CVRD's value.

CVRD is due to be privatized in February next year with the minimum price being announced only 60 days before the auction in order to allow enough time to assess the impact of the ICMS tax cut on the company's value.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
